hunt.justification: NetScaler appliances are high-value perimeter targets; an unauthenticated bypass (CVE-2026-19490) allows direct internal access, making a negative result a critical security requirement.

meta.name: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass and Exposure

related.reason: This hunt focuses on the authentication bypass; post-exploitation shell activity on the underlying Linux OS requires different telemetry surfaces.

meta.analysis: A standard signature-based detection for this CVE might be evaded by minor adjustments in the exploit payload; this hunt instead looks for the behavioral aftermath—successful, rare authentications and anomalous web patterns on vulnerable perimeter systems.

stages.name: Unauthorized External Remote Access
observables: Successful gateway login without valid credential record

scenario.summary: Attackers can bypass authentication on Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances via CVE-2026-19490, a critical vulnerability affecting systems configured with SAML or VPN virtual servers. This allows unauthenticated remote access to the perimeter device, providing a foothold for initial access into the corporate network.

meta.rationale: Focus on internet-exposed appliances first by cross-referencing vulnerability scans with external asset inventory. Use the hostnames from the vulnerability findings to populate the scope_hosts parameter for the behavioral queries.
meta.hypothesis: An unauthenticated attacker has exploited CVE-2026-19490 on an internet-facing NetScaler appliance to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized remote access.

scope_hosts.description: List of hostnames or resource IDs for the identified vulnerable NetScaler appliances.

references.name: Rapid7 — CVE-2026-19490: Critical Vulnerability Affecting Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway

blind_spots.risk: If logs are not centralized, the prevalence and behavioral queries will return zero results even if exploitation is occurring.
blind_spots.question: Are the appliances configured to forward HTTP and authentication logs?
blind_spots.requires: Syslog ingestion from NetScaler to hb_http_activity and hb_auth_signin

blind_spots.risk: If the bypass occurs purely at the protocol level (e.g., SAML assertion injection) and the appliance does not log it as a standard 'logon', the auth prevalence query will miss it.
blind_spots.question: Can the bypass establish a session without a recorded logon event?

hunt.name: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass and Exposure
hunt.description: This hunt identifies Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway appliances vulnerable to CVE-2026-19490 and evaluates signs of exploitation. It first scopes the estate using vulnerability findings for the specific CVE. It then analyzes authentication patterns and HTTP traffic targeting sensitive SAML and VPN endpoints on those systems to identify rare source IPs and anomalous access that indicate a successful authentication bypass.

nodes.label: Prevalence of successful authentication by source IP

config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, COUNT(*) AS login_events, MIN(time) AS first_seen, MAX(time) AS last_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (LOWER(metadata_product) LIKE '%citrix%' OR LOWER(provider) LIKE '%citrix%') AND status_id = 1 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip HAVING host_count <= 2 ORDER BY host_count ASC, login_events DESC
config.description: Identify rare external IP addresses successfully authenticating to NetScaler services, which may indicate bypassed authentication.
config.expected_signal: Source IPs that have only successfully logged into one or two appliances stand out from regular corporate VPN users.

primitive_config.label: Prevalence of successful authentication by source IP
primitive_config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, COUNT(*) AS login_events, MIN(time) AS first_seen, MAX(time) AS last_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (LOWER(metadata_product) LIKE '%citrix%' OR LOWER(provider) LIKE '%citrix%') AND status_id = 1 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip HAVING host_count <= 2 ORDER BY host_count ASC, login_events DESC
primitive_config.expected: Source IPs that have only successfully logged into one or two appliances stand out from regular corporate VPN users.

nodes.label: Anomalous web access to SAML and VPN endpoints

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_path, url_query, src_endpoint_ip, user_agent, status_code, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/logon/%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/saml/%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/vpn/%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') ORDER BY time DESC
config.description: Identify unusual HTTP request patterns targeting sensitive NetScaler authentication and gateway paths.
config.expected_signal: Access to SAML or VPN endpoints from IPs identified as rare in the prevalence step, or requests that return successful status codes without typical precursor sessions.
